messages.author: 67571e909b2d8a9a
messages.subject: Error with read.bismark
parts:
Hi,

Could I please get some advice on the following issue. I have encountered the following error using the read.bismark function:

Error in methylation calling...

Make sure the file is sorted correctly and it is a legitimate Bismark SAM file

In addition: Warning message:

In dir.create(save.folder, showWarnings = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, :

'/scratch/p/pmcgowan/bhing/methylkit_output' already exists

My sam files were created using bismark version 0.13.1 and I have double checked that the sam files were sorted by chromosome coordinates by samtools before using the read.bismark function in methylkit. I am using R version 3.1.1, methylkit version 0.9.2 and samtools 1-2

I have used this workflow successfully in the past ( months ago) so I am unsure what is causing the problem. I suspect it might be something to do with incompatibility between versions of one of the programs.

Could someone please point me in the right direction?

Thanks
